latestVersion.changelog:
editor-effects 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Instantly apply cinematic color grading, smooth transitions, and professional visual/audio effects to video clips via a simple upload and instruction flow.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB for fast, cloud-rendered outputs (typically 30–90 seconds per edit).
- Automatic session and token management enables quick onboarding, including free starter credits for new users.
- Clean chat interface: users describe the desired effect, receive real-time status updates, and get a ready-to-download enhanced video without technical jargon.
- Common workflows documented: quick single-edit, batch processing, and iterative refinement, all tracked in a persistent session.
